# Custom Truck Insurance

> Custom Truck Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: Agreed Value Coverage for custom trucks, Custom Parts & Equipment for custom trucks, Liability Insurance for custom trucks, Physical Damage for custom trucks, Non-Trucking Liability for custom trucks, Commercial Auto for custom trucks, Umbrella Insurance for custom trucks, GAP Coverage for custom trucks. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
